narrative.overview:
Quiet ink surfaces and restrained sea-glass teal support a focused local research workspace. The approved Figma direction now lives in a dedicated HTML/CSS/JavaScript presentation, with local Manrope headings and DM Sans body text. Tonal layers give the ambient character without decorative light effects.

The system favors legible questions, source records and review fields over ornament. Native buttons, fields, disclosures and dialogs carry the interaction; clear state cues keep uncertainty and confirmation visible within the conversation.

2026-10-09: Answer-first conversation with a compact Sources selector per response. Detailed references, supporting passages and limitations live in the right evidence panel or native mobile sources drawer. Welcome actions use a flat list; central content is centered at a 760px maximum measure. Safe-area padding and 44px controls apply on phones.

2026-10-10: Informational answers use Simple explanation followed by Deeper explanation with 18px/600 headings and existing 15px body text. Source qualifications remain visible; the evidence panel identifies the supported layers. Missing checked depth is stated explicitly; urgent guidance remains direct.
keyCharacteristics: Deep ink canvas with tonal rails and surfaces.
Sea-glass teal for identity, actions, selection and focus.
Manrope headings paired with DM Sans body text.
Shared controls, restrained borders and responsive access to context.

rules.name: The Context Rule
rules.body: Use teal for interaction and context; reserve amber for pending review and caution, and the urgent pair for urgent guidance or errors.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tonal fills and thin borders for depth. Keep decorative glow and shadows out of controls.

dos: **Do** reuse the control and surface radii, tonal fills and shared button treatments.
**Do** retain visible labels, native controls, keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** keep sources, uncertainty and confirmation cues beside the result they qualify.
**Do** preserve one conversation and the link-icon attachment entry point.
donts: **Don't** add glowing controls or decorative animations.
**Don't** add decorative medical illustrations, invented health metrics, confidence badges or fake activity charts.
**Don't** render user or model content as unsafe HTML.
**Don't** imply that category routing or confirmed transcription establishes clinical validity.
